📚 XAUUSD Lesson: The Power of Market Structure
Many traders focus only on indicators, but professional traders focus on market structure first.
🔹 Higher Highs (HH) & Higher Lows (HL) = Bullish Trend
When Gold keeps creating higher highs and higher lows, buyers are in control. The best opportunities are usually found on pullbacks rather than chasing price.
🔹 Lower Highs (LH) & Lower Lows (LL) = Bearish Trend
When Gold starts forming lower highs and lower lows, sellers dominate the market. Selling from resistance becomes safer than buying against the trend.
🔹 Break of Structure (BOS)
A BOS occurs when price breaks a significant swing high or swing low. This often signals trend continuation and confirms market direction.
🔹 Change of Character (CHoCH)
A CHoCH is the first warning that the current trend may be ending. It usually appears before a major reversal and helps traders prepare for a new market direction.
💡 Trading Rule:
Never enter a trade just because price looks cheap or expensive. First identify the market structure, then trade in the direction of the dominant trend.
Remember: Trend first, entry second. Most losing trades happen when traders ignore market structure and trade against momentum. 📈

Price broke out of a Bearish Range channel in late April, confirming sustained selling pressure. Early May saw a bullish BOS that swept the first SSL zone (~4,490–4,510), but smart money distributed at the highs mid-May with a bearish BOS near 4,650, triggering a sharp drop to the swing low at 4,367 on May 27. Price is currently reacting upward, filling the FVG between 4,453–4,540.
Bias for next week: Sell on rally. As long as price respects the 4,540–4,590 SSL/FVG zone as resistance, expect bearish continuation back toward 4,453 and potentially a retest of the 4,367 low. No confirmed bullish BOS on H4 yet — watch for a manipulation wick into the SSL zone before distribution resumes.
Invalidation: H4 close above 4,620 with momentum flips the bias bullish, targeting the 4,773 area.
